අƯ ɪෙශෂThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
THE SRI LANKA ARMED SERVICE LONG SERVICE MEDAL AND CLASP
IT is hereby notified that His Excellency the President has been pleased to award the Sri Lanka Armed Services Long Service Medal and Clasp to the person specified in the schedule hereto

Air Vice Marshal SAMPATH THUYACONTHA (Retd) WWV,RWP and two Bars,RSP and Bar, USP,MMSc (Strat Stu-China), MSc(Def Stu) in Mgt, MSc(Def and Strat Stu),fndu (China),psc Secretary, Ministry of Defence. At Colombo.01st September, 2025.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
